title: SS27 Girls' Partywear Styling
summary: Party girlswear: sparkle, bold colour and reversible dresses.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Pitti Bimbo 103 took "The Pitti Pool" as its theme and called it "the most colorful summer edition yet"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Poco Blush, designed "almost exclusively for girls", showed bold hues and a loose, printed, reversible dress, and a T-shirt that releases a minty scent when crumpled<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Bright dress + sparkle hair clip.**
- **Sequin top + skirt.**
- **Reversible dress.**

design_implications:
- Line sequins.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Pitti Bimbo 103: the energy of summer ignites kidswear
Pitti Bimbo in Florence proves the merits of an intimate format
